rationale: High-contrast authoritative layout to build trust and convey clear data for IT Niche LLC. Eliminating images focuses attention completely on service capabilities and precise statistics.

headings.note: Replaces generic fonts for headings to add E1 tension and a premium B2B agency feel.

body.note: User-selected Lato kept for maximum readability in body text, labels, and form inputs.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Protocol Mode A (The Tetris Grid) combined with Mode B (Control Room) for data stats.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-16 for containers. Gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp or minimal. rounded-none or max rounded-md (6px) to keep corporate precision.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB on surfaces to expose the skeleton (Grid Borders style).

visual_enhancers.rule: CRITICAL: NO IMAGES. NO HUMANS. Use SVG, CSS, and code-based visuals only.

icons.style: Large scale (w-12 to w-16), 1.5px stroke, colored in #000000 or #e57119.

infographics.style: Geometric shapes, progress bars, step-lines, and large numeric data points. Pure Tailwind CSS for bar visuals or Recharts if complex.

textures.style: Subtle dot matrix patterns (.bg-dot-black/[0.1]) or thin 1px grid background lines on hero/stats sections.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E5E7EB), no shadow default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), shadow-lg, border color shifts to #e57119.
components.buttons: Sharp rectangular edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#e57119] text-white hover:bg-[#cc6516]. Secondary: outline 1px solid #000000 text-[#000000] hover:bg-[#000000] hover:text-white.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. White bg, 1px border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#e57119] focus:border-[#e57119].

header.layout: Sticky glassmorphism nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Logo left, Nav center, CTA right.

hero.content_left: H1: Massive geometric typography (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Subheadline: 1-2 lines. Primary CTA + Secondary CTA.
hero.content_right: Abstract geometric SVG layout or pure CSS-based dashboard metric representation (e.g., glowing bar charts, floating metric cards, concentric circles).

services_bento.layout: Asymmetrical Bento Grid. 4-6 cards showcasing Web Design, Digital Marketing, SEO, Custom Solutions.
services_bento.visuals: Large Lucide icons. Minimal text blocks (breadcrumbs). Hover reveals active state.

stats_infographic.layout: Full width dark section (bg-[#000000] text-white) to create visual tension and break the light theme.
stats_infographic.visuals: Massive typography for numbers (e.g., '20+', '500+'). Accent labels with #e57119.

process_timeline.layout: Vertical or horizontal timeline using SVG connecting lines.
process_timeline.visuals: Numbered steps (1, 2, 3) inside high-contrast circles. Brief headers and 1-line descriptions.

global_presence.visuals: USA and India represented by clean geographic SVG outlines or architectural/pin line-art icons. Address details text heavy.

contact.layout: Grid split: Left side 'Let's Talk' typography and contact details, Right side static form.
contact.form: Shadcn form styles. Submit button uses #e57119.

footer.layout: Massive typography for tagline 'Your feedback is Oxygen for us!' (text-[6vw] to text-[8vw] font-black). Clean link columns below.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add Google Fonts import to CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lato:wght@400;700&family=Outfit:wght@400;700;900&display=swap');
Configure tailwind.config.js to use 'Outfit' for sans and 'Lato' for body font variables.
Build strictly responsive grid structures without reliance on fixed heights where content flows.
Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast, especially the orange #e57119 against white.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use any tags for realistic photos or stock photos. Use ONLY SVG shapes, pure CSS constructs, and lucide-react icons.
Implement data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as defined.
Apply 'Bento grid' styling for the services section.
Use framer-motion for simple staggered reveals on scroll for the infographic elements.
